subject: using sim.geno with the binary model

messages.author: 8dc60bf1b7e5126a
messages.subject: using sim.geno with the binary model
parts:
I'm trying to generate the 'sim.geno' simulation (to get a LOD score
estimation for each point not just for the markers). the model that I'm
working with is the binary model and the EM method. for some reason, I
could not produce the right graph using the binary model. when I was
trying to simulate by using the normal model and the 'imp' method, it
actually worked. unfortunately, using the normal model with my data is
not an option.
so I was wondering whether there is a way to simulate the data
(sim.geno) and still use the binary model?
any help will be most appreciated.

messages.author: f388084a0de67b60
messages.subject: Re: using sim.geno with the binary model
parts:
We've not yet implemented the fit of models with binary
phenotypes by imputation, and it's not high on my priority
list.

Could you give further details about why you "could
not produce the right graph"?

For scanone with the binary model, you need to first run
calc.genoprob() to calculate genotype probabilities. Had
you done that?

Kind regards,
karl
